gloss: prophetic dream; dream that comes true

definitions.gloss: prophetic dream; dream that comes true
definitions.explanation: A dream whose content later becomes reality. In Japanese folk belief, dreams seen in the early morning hours are said to be more likely to come true.

examples.japanese: あの{夢|ゆめ}は{正夢|まさゆめ}だった。
examples.english: That dream turned out to be prophetic.

examples.japanese: {正夢|まさゆめ}にならないといいけど。
examples.english: I hope it doesn't come true.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}た{翌日|よくじつ}に{本当|ほんとう}に{揺|ゆ}れたので、{正夢|まさゆめ}だと{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I dreamed about an earthquake and there was really one the next day, so I was amazed it was a prophetic dream.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in conversation when something dreamt about coincidentally happens in real life. The opposite concept is {逆夢|さかゆめ} (a dream where the opposite comes true).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正夢|まさゆめ}になる (to come true — of a dream)
- {正夢|まさゆめ}だった (it was a prophetic dream)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆夢|さかゆめ}: dream with opposite meaning — what you dreamt about happens in reverse
- {予知夢|よちゆめ}: precognitive dream — more scientific or paranormal framing
